## Pre processing

```{r}
data <- data[, 1:45]
data$target <- as.factor(data$target)
```

```{r}
# 표준화 함수
normalizer <- function(x) {
  return((x-mean(x))/sd(x))
}
```

```{r}
for(i in 1:45){
  if(i == 4) next
  data[,i] = normalizer(data[,i])
}
```

# Modeling PseudoCode

```{r, warning = FALSE}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
cost_grid <- c(0.001,0.01,0.1,1,4,16)
gamma_grid <- c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(cost in cost_grid){
    for(gamma in gamma_grid){
      for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
        CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
        train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
        train_index <- c(1:n) 
        train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
        test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
        test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
        # Train 데이터셋이 필요한 경우
        Model <- svm(target ~ ., data = train, cost = cost, gamma = gamma, kernel = "radial")
        
        
        # Prediction (0, 1로 나오는 경우)
        pred <- predict(Model, newdata = test)
        
        # Update Scores
        Accuracy_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_SVMR[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
        FPR_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(FPR_SVMR[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
        FNR_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(FNR_SVMR[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
        F1_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(F1_SVMR[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))
      }
      
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_SVMR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(cost_grid)){
    for(param2 in 1:length(gamma_grid)){
      CVAccuracy_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_SVMR[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_SVMR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(gamma_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFPR_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_SVMR[[seed]], mean(FPR_SVMR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(gamma_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFNR_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_SVMR[[seed]], mean(FNR_SVMR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(gamma_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVF1_SVMR[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_SVMR[[seed]], mean(F1_SVMR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(gamma_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
    }
  }
}
```

## Accuracy

```{r}
SVMR_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(CVAccuracy_SVMR)
colnames(SVMR_Accuracy) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
SVMR_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(SVMR_Accuracy)))

SVMR_Accuracy
```

```{r}
SVMR_Accuracy <- SVMR_Accuracy%>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Accuracy")%>%
  mutate(gamma = gamma_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%(length(gamma_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(cost = cost_grid[(((row_number()-1)%/%K)%/%(length(gamma_grid)))+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)

SVMR_Accuracy%>%
  filter(Accuracy > 0.6)%>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = Accuracy, y = Parameter), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_text(aes(x = Accuracy, y = Parameter, label = cost), stat = "summary", hjust = -3, size = 3)+
  geom_text(aes(x = Accuracy, y = Parameter, label = gamma), stat = "summary", hjust = 3, size = 3)+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("SVM Radial", subtitle = "Accuracy")
```


## F1 score

```{r}
SVMR_F1 <- as.data.frame(CVF1_SVMR)
colnames(SVMR_F1) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
SVMR_F1 <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(SVMR_F1)))

SVMR_F1
```

```{r}
SVMR_F1 <- SVMR_F1 %>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "F1")%>%
  mutate(gamma = gamma_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%(length(gamma_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(cost = cost_grid[(((row_number()-1)%/%K)%/%(length(gamma_grid)))+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)%>%
  na.omit()


SVMR_F1%>%
  filter(F1 > 0.5)%>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = F1, y = Parameter))+
  geom_text(aes(x = F1, y = Parameter, label = cost), stat = "summary", hjust = -2, size = 3)+
  geom_text(aes(x = F1, y = Parameter, label = gamma), stat = "summary", hjust = 2, size = 3)+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("SVM Radial", subtitle = "F1 score")
```
